vge_method: Precordial echo imaging with audible and visual signals three times per hour, grouped Spencer grades.
dcs_endpoint: Exposure-ending DCS signs or symptoms or Grade 2 joint pain, as defined in Methods.
note: 32 healthy men. The resting exposure was selected to be symptom-free at the chosen altitude. At the 29,500 ft ceiling the threshold may be higher. Four exercise conditions followed in randomized order. The 20-min exercise cycle includes 5 min rest, 5 min ultrasound, 5 min rest, 1 min preparation and 4 min exercise, with short walks between stations. Nominal 100% oxygen was scheduled before and at altitude. Participant-specific exposure order, timing, delivered gas and follow-up are unavailable.
